what: Indicative probe for the Opus decoder choice (docs/design/audio-decode.md, "Opus"); not a bar, not held-out.
host: development VM, Intel Xeon @ 2.50GHz, 8 vCPU, Amazon Linux 2023
inputs: the 13 largest non-held-out corpus v1 files with an Opus stream in MP4/Matroska/WebM whose download fit, first audio stream remuxed by stream copy to .mka, those of 40 s and more
ffmpeg: /opt/coreav-oracle-bin/ffmpeg 7.0.2-static (johnvansickle), libopus 1.3.1 linked statically, build flags unknown
method_ffmpeg: ffmpeg -threads 1 -c:a {opus|libopus} -i IN -map 0:a:0 -f s16le /dev/null, wall time, median of 3 alternated runs (1 run above 1000 s); opus_probe/ffmpeg_decoders.py
method_loop: Amazon Linux 2023 libopus 1.3.1 (opus-devel 1.3.1-8.amzn2023.0.3), opus_decode to s16 in a loop over packets held in memory, decode time only, 2 runs; opus_probe/libopus_loop.c, packets from an Ogg remux by opus_probe/ogg_packets.py; the ratio uses the mean of the 2 runs
reproduce: inputs: ffmpeg -i IN -map 0:a:0 -c copy OUT.mka for each corpus file; python3 opus_probe/ffmpeg_decoders.py (reads /tmp/opusprobe/a/*.mka, no warm-up run); ffmpeg -i OUT.mka -map 0:a:0 -c copy OUT.ogg; python3 opus_probe/ogg_packets.py OUT.ogg OUT.pk; gcc -O2 opus_probe/libopus_loop.c -lopus -o loop; ./loop OUT.pk CHANNELS
